Maria G.: Morning check — queue at 42 tickets (slightly up), P1 = none, P2 = 1 (payment gateway timeout). Pulling a quick heatmap after standup.
Devon S.: ack, can you drop the P2 id? I can take first look.
Maria G.: XYZ-7621. Error shows 502 from our billing upstream intermittently.
Aj Patel: saw similar spike last night, suspected circuit breaker misfire on retry logic. Left a note in the ticket.
Priya (support-lead): thanks — can someone confirm macros updated to include the new billing link and the troubleshooting steps? We had a couple of customers sent old KB.
Maria G.: updated macro `billing-gateway-timeout` at 06:40. Quick diff below:
```
- Please try clearing cache
+ We saw intermittent 502s from vendor gateway. If you see `gateway_timeout`, please: 1) confirm card network is reachable, 2) retry once after 30s, 3) collect `txn-id` and escalate to support on duty.
```
Devon S.: nice. Added a step to capture `txn-id` in the webhook payload.
ops-bot: deploy finished: staging -> canary (service: payments, ver: v3.2.7) :white_check_mark:
Kevin L.: pinging infra for circuit-breaker logs — @oncall-sre can you share the last 3m spike?
Priya (support-lead): quick hotlist for the shift: 1) XYZ-7621 (P2) 2) ABC-341 (embedding latency) 3) GH-998 (billing invoice mismatch). Keep macros: billing-gateway-timeout, emb-latency-basic, invoice-mismatch.
Devon S.: taking XYZ-7621, will update with logs.
Aj Patel: I flattened a small bucket of stale retries so total queue should drop ~6 in next 10m.
Maria G.: noted — if anyone sees repeated customers getting old KB link, ping me and I'll rollback change.
Priya (support-lead): handoff at 11:00 PST — please drop any long-running follow-ups in the thread so oncall can pick up.
Devon S.: quick question — should we add an assertion in the macro that includes the `customer-region`? saves time when routing to regionally-scoped teams.
Priya (support-lead): yes, do it. Keep it concise. Example: `Region: <us-west-2>` at top.
Maria G.: will add region line and push macro patch.
jira-bot: ticket XYZ-7621 assigned to Devon S. by Maria G.
Kevin L.: infra sent logs — looks like a transient 502 from upstream around 06:31, rate-limited flowback. Putting a short note on the ticket.
Aj Patel: will monitor for next 30m and flag if it reappears.
Maria G.: thanks all — quick status update in 20m. :thumbsup:
Priya (support-lead): :raised_hands: good coverage, team. If load creeps again we'll escalate to dedicated routing.
